description: Complete exact length, distinct-output count and constructive classification of shortest common supersequences of a permutation power and an opposite-order power, for all positive exponents.
integrity: An infinite-parameter proof is supplied. Standalone finite checks are supporting evidence only, not an infinite proof. Numerical central-binomial coefficients are classical; the claimed contribution is the reverse-power SCS interpretation, the all-exponent formula and the explicit output bijection.
limitations: No results for arbitrary base-order pairs, for more than two input strings, or for nonshortest inclusion-minimal common supersequences. Prior equivalent formulations may be unindexed; independent scientific audit is not performed.
title: A binomial law for shortest common supersequences of opposite permutation powers
